sentence: This project tries to find out how kidney injury and long-term kidney disease start by following patients and storing their clinical data in a database.
This project tries to find out what makes people unaware of their own errors after a stroke, especially with limb apraxia.
This project tests how to make a treatment that uses immune cells to kill cancer safer, using pediatric brain tumor models.
This project describes how the center reviews and keeps track of clinical research protocols involving cancer patients.
This project studies how mutations in a machine that controls RNA cause brain problems, using human 3D neuronal cultures made from stem cells.
This project builds a system that uses real-time imaging to track moving lung tumors and check the radiation dose during treatment.
This project studies how small cell lung carcinoma cells change state to survive chemotherapy.
This project tests whether imaging can guide prostate cancer surgery so nerves and muscles near the prostate are preserved.
This project studies how neurons keep their activity stable over time, using a genetic model system.
This project tries to find out how a receptor helps Venezuelan equine encephalitis virus enter cells and cause disease.
This project tries to find out what keeps malaria spreading during the dry season in rural and urban settings.
This project builds an organoid model of the cerebellum to find out how a gene mutation causes a disabling nerve disease.
This project builds human stem cell lines with knockout genes and studies how losing a gene changes traits in different genetic backgrounds.
This project uses human tonsil organoids to study why HIV infected cells make no viral proteins.
This project uses machine learning on electroencephalography recordings to build a tool that helps detect and monitor catatonia.
This project studies how handling and pooling human milk changes the release of peptides in the gut of preterm infants.
This project uses math and experiments to study how evolution makes lung cancer resistant to therapy.
This project tests drugs in genetically heterogeneous mice to find out whether they increase healthy lifespan.
This project searches for genetic causes of eating disorders, including anorexia nervosa and bulimia nervosa.
This project studies whether breast MRI can help decide early when to switch treatment and predict long-term outcomes.
